Questions

Before you buy.

Do I need technical skills?

No. Every step is written for non-technical owners. You copy a prompt, paste it into Claude and read what comes back. The one chapter about Claude Code is optional and clearly marked.

Which Claude plan do I need?

A Claude account. A paid plan (Pro or higher) unlocks Projects and most features used in the books. Vol 6's skills run in Claude Code, on your computer or in the cloud. Features depend on your plan and change over time, so every workflow also has a simple copy-paste version.

Will Claude send messages or emails without me?

No. The system is built on one rule: Claude drafts, you approve and send. Complaints, refunds, pricing and anything legal always stay with you.

What format are the ebooks?

Designed PDFs (7 × 10 in) that read well on a phone, tablet or computer. After checkout, Gumroad gives you an instant download link and emails it to you.

Which volume should I start with?

Vol 1 if you run a business, Vol 6 if you're a creator. Vol 1 helps you find where your hours go and tells you which volume to read next. If you already know your biggest problem, jump straight to that volume.

Are the statistics real?

Yes. Every statistic comes from a named source (Harvard Business Review, BrightLocal, NBER, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce and others), listed in a sources page at the end of each book. Stories in the books are labeled as composite examples.

Do you guarantee I'll save 10 hours?

No honest guide can guarantee a number. You get a clear, tested system. How many hours you win back depends on your business and how consistently you use the routines.

Is this an official Anthropic product?

No. Hire Claude is an independent guide written for business owners who use Claude. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

Do I get updates?

Yes. When a volume is updated, buyers get the new version for free through their Gumroad library.
